title: Obsidian Knowledge Bridge — Bidirectional Sync, Plugin Bridge, and Shop Floor Note Integration
description: Bidirectional integration between PRISM manufacturing intelligence and Obsidian knowledge management. Syncs tribal tips, shop floor notes, and structured knowledge between systems. Provides plugin API bridge for live Obsidian workspace integration.
goals: Enable bidirectional sync between PRISM knowledge base and Obsidian vaults
Create Obsidian plugin bridge for real-time PRISM queries from within Obsidian
Export tribal tips to Obsidian-compatible markdown with proper linking
Ingest shop floor notes captured in Obsidian back into PRISM knowledge graph

units.title: ObsidianVaultSyncEngine — Bidirectional Knowledge Sync
units.description: Engine for bidirectional synchronization between PRISM's knowledge base and Obsidian vaults. Handles conflict resolution, incremental sync, and metadata mapping. Supports multiple vault configurations per user.
deliverables: Wire 4 actions to prism_knowledge: obsidian_sync_pull, obsidian_sync_push, obsidian_sync_status, obsidian_sync_config
acceptance_criteria: Pull changes from Obsidian vault into PRISM knowledge entries
Push PRISM knowledge updates to Obsidian markdown files
Detect and report sync conflicts with resolution options
Track sync state with checksums to enable incremental sync
Tests cover: empty vault, conflict scenarios, large file handling, link preservation

units.title: ObsidianPluginBridge — Plugin API Integration
units.description: Bridge engine enabling Obsidian plugins to query PRISM MCP actions directly. Provides HTTP/WebSocket endpoints for plugin communication. Handles authentication and rate limiting for multi-user scenarios.
deliverables: Wire 5 actions to prism_knowledge: obsidian_plugin_register, obsidian_plugin_query, obsidian_plugin_subscribe, obsidian_plugin_unsubscribe, obsidian_plugin_status
acceptance_criteria: Register Obsidian plugin instances with API keys
Execute PRISM MCP queries from plugin context
Subscribe to knowledge update events for live sync
Rate limit and authenticate plugin requests
Tests cover: auth flow, query execution, event subscription, error handling

units.title: TribalTipExportEngine — Tribal Knowledge to Obsidian
units.description: Exports PRISM tribal tips to Obsidian-compatible markdown with proper wiki-links, frontmatter, and tag structure. Maintains bidirectional link integrity. Supports bulk export and incremental updates.
deliverables: Wire 4 actions to prism_knowledge: tribal_export_single, tribal_export_bulk, tribal_export_config, tribal_export_status
acceptance_criteria: Export single tribal tip to Obsidian markdown with frontmatter
Bulk export with wiki-link generation between related tips
Configure export templates and tag mappings
Track export state for incremental updates
Tests cover: frontmatter generation, wiki-link syntax, tag mapping, bulk performance

units.title: ShopFloorNoteIngestionEngine — Obsidian Notes to PRISM
units.description: Ingests shop floor notes captured in Obsidian into PRISM's knowledge graph. Parses markdown structure, extracts entities (machines, materials, operations), and creates knowledge entries with proper relationships.
deliverables: Wire 5 actions to prism_knowledge: shop_note_ingest, shop_note_parse, shop_note_batch, shop_note_validate, shop_note_status
acceptance_criteria: Parse Obsidian markdown notes with structured headers
Extract machine, material, and operation entities via NER
Create knowledge graph entries with relationships
Validate extracted entities against PRISM registries
Tests cover: entity extraction, relationship creation, validation failures, batch ingestion

existing_engines_to_leverage: TribalKnowledgeEngine — existing tribal tip storage and retrieval
TribalRAGEngine — existing RAG for tribal knowledge queries
KnowledgeGraphEngine — existing KG for entity relationships
